description:
An update for Mario & Luigi™: Dream Team Bros. is now available from Nintendo eShop. This will update the software to Version 1.1.

• Once the update has been downloaded, it will be installed automatically.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and recommend downloading this update to ensure a smooth game experience.
disclaimer:
Updated data for Nintendo 3DS title Mario & Luigi™: Dream Team.

After the download, the icon for this data won't appear on the Nintendo 3DS HOME Menu. The data will instead appear in System Settings under Extra Data, so please don't delete it.

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
